label: Numeracy (HALDO)
description: Mean of available HALDO numeracy domains

label: Attendance rate
description: Days attended divided by possible attendance days while enrolled

label: Chronic absence
description: Learner attended less than 90% of possible days

label: Retained in programme
description: Learner remains enrolled through the defined programme cycle

label: Programme completion
description: Learner completed the grade, level or programme

label: Certified or transitioned
description: Learner certified or transitioned to formal or further education

label: Child wellbeing
description: Validated child wellbeing scale score

label: Perceived safety
description: Child-reported safety in, to and from the learning space

label: Safety knowledge
description: Share of unsafe-situation identification and reporting items answered correctly

label: MHPSS participation
description: Number of structured MHPSS sessions attended in the period

label: PSS/play participation
description: Number of structured recreational or psychosocial play sessions attended

label: Positive feedback
description: Observed quality and frequency of constructive feedback

label: Checks for understanding
description: Observed use of checks for learner understanding

label: Cognitive challenge
description: Observed opportunities for analysis, reasoning and problem solving

label: Differentiation
description: Observed adaptation of teaching to learner needs and levels

label: Student participation
description: Observed breadth and quality of learner participation

label: Positive discipline
description: Observed use of non-violent, constructive classroom discipline

label: Disability-inclusive practice
description: Observed adaptations and participation support for learners with disabilities

label: Inclusive practice index
description: Mean of available gender- and disability-inclusive classroom-practice domains

label: Teaching practice index
description: Mean of available observed teaching-practice domains

label: Teacher attendance rate
description: Days present divided by days expected to teach

label: CPD support dosage
description: Structured CPD, coaching, mentoring or learning-circle events attended

label: Inclusive training completed
description: Teacher completed inclusive-education and positive-discipline training

label: Inclusion knowledge and attitudes
description: Teacher knowledge and attitude score for disability and gender inclusion

label: Teacher wellbeing
description: Teacher wellbeing or psychological health scale score

label: Teacher stress or burnout
description: Validated stress or burnout scale score

label: Class size
description: Number of learners enrolled in the observed or assigned class

label: Building condition
description: Overall condition of school buildings and learning spaces

label: Classroom adequacy
description: Usable classrooms as a share of classrooms required for current enrolment

label: WASH functionality
description: Mean availability of functional water, toilets and handwashing facilities

label: Physical accessibility
description: Mean availability of key physical accessibility features

label: Learning material adequacy
description: Learning-material sets available per enrolled learner

label: School closure days
description: Number of planned school days lost in the reporting period

label: School shock intensity
description: Composite of disruption, displacement pressure, security incidents and resource interruption

label: Functioning referral mechanism
description: Referral pathway, focal point and active referral log are all present

label: PSS quality standard met
description: At least three of four PSS quality attributes are met

label: Functioning code of conduct
description: Code exists, is enforced and has been communicated to staff and community

label: Safety training reach
description: Number of head teachers and teachers trained in bullying prevention and positive discipline

label: Personal-safety lessons delivered
description: Number of personal-safety lessons delivered in the reporting period

label: PSS sessions delivered
description: Number of structured psychosocial or recreational sessions delivered

label: PSS curriculum fidelity
description: Share of planned structured PSS activity types delivered

label: Active learning-circle groups
description: Number of teacher learning-circle groups meeting the activity standard

label: CPD session fidelity
description: Share of intended pedagogical content evidenced in CPD session records

label: Training content coverage
description: Share of required inclusive-training content domains covered

label: Teacher support reach
description: Number of teachers receiving self-care or SEL support with referral access

label: Data-review frequency
description: Number of structured school data-review meetings in the period

label: Infrastructure quality index
description: Standardised composite of building, classroom, WASH, accessibility and material conditions

label: Over-age learners enrolled in AEP
description: Count of enumerator-confirmed over-age learners enrolled in the AEP

label: Caregiver programme completion
description: Number of caregivers completing the structured parenting or family-support programme

label: Caregiver support reach
description: Number of caregivers participating in structured caregiver-support sessions

label: Caregiver-support fidelity
description: Share of intended caregiver-support content delivered

label: Home learning support improved
description: Child reports improved learning or wellbeing support at home

label: PSS facilitator training days
description: Number of structured PSS facilitator training days completed

description: Improved wellbeing among children participating in classroom-based structured PSS

label: Structured play sessions delivered
description: Number of structured recreational and psychosocial play sessions delivered
